documents.text: #### getDefaultJsonParser `fastify.getDefaultJsonParser(onProtoPoisoning, onConstructorPoisoning)` takes two arguments. First argument is ProtoType poisoning configuration and second argument is constructor poisoning configuration. See the [`secure-json-parse` documentation](https://github.com/fastify/secure-json-parse#api) for more information.
